messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from last week's postmortem (BR-2026). Need to lock owners/timelines for rollout safety items: auto-rollback policy, containment templates, telemetry + runbook hooks. Can owners ack?
Maya: I'll take auto-rollback policy + PR to runtime. Will add unit + integration tests. ETA Fri 2026-03-28. @Sam assign ACTION-342.
Connor: I'll own containment/flag templates (feature-flag scopes, per-service rate caps). ETA Mon 2026-04-04. ACTION-343.
Priya: Adding rollout telemetry: regression smoke tests + runbook integration. I'll add metrics, dashboards, and alert playbooks. Need clarity on min sample sizes; suggest minSample=100. ETA Wed 2026-04-06. ACTION-344.
Alex: Oncall will add Ops dashboard and implement quarantine timer for guarded rollouts. Proposed quarantine: 3m + auto-pause. ETA Tue 2026-03-30. ACTION-345.
ops-bot: ticket INF-789 created: rollout-drift-alerts (linked to BR-2026).
Maya: Draft policy snippet for runtime config: 
```json
{
  "autoRollback": true,
  "threshold_pct_errors": 5,
  "window_secs": 120,
  "min_sample": 100,
  "fallback_model": "redwood-safe-v1"
}
```
Connor: For containment templates, propose a small DSL: `scope: {percent_users: 10, regions: ["us-west-2"]}`, and `max_concurrent: 1000` for hot paths. We'll include default per-service caps.
Priya: Telemetry rules to gate rollouts:
- error_rate > 3% (over window)
- p50 latency increase > 20%
Both should be ANDed with min_sample before triggering auto-rollback.
Sam: OK. Can we have the PRs by the ETAs above and update the postmortem tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortem/BR-2026?action-tracker
Connor: ack — I'll pair with Maya for integration tests on Thursday afternoon.
Maya: ack — opening runtime PR today and adding reviewers @Priya @Sam.
Alex: I'll schedule a 15m sync Friday to validate dashboard signals and quarantine behavior. Invite sent.
Sam: Thanks everyone — I'll own closure verification and ensure the recurring-incident checklist is updated. Follow-up check-in in two weeks (2026-04-07). :thumbsup:
